errors.evidence: The x-axis is not explicitly labeled with the word "година" (year); it only has the numerical years as tick labels.
The y-axis has no label. The unit (EUR) is derived from the figure's caption, not from an axis label in the image.
The line in the chart is grey/black, not dark blue.

errors.text_span: започва при стойност 15000 EUR през 2012 г.
errors.evidence: The line in 2012 starts at a value visibly above 15000, approximately 15,800. Stating it starts 'at' 15000 is incorrect.

errors.text_span: достигайки стойност от около 20200 EUR през 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The value in 2019 is visibly above 21000, closer to 21,500. The reported value of 20,200 is a significant underestimate and is closer to the value from 2017.

errors.text_span: От 2015 г. до 2017 г. се наблюдава по-плавно нарастване, след което линията отново показва по-стръмно покачване до 2019 г.
errors.evidence: This description of the trend's changes is inaccurate. The growth rate increases significantly from 2016 to 2017, it is not a 'smoother increase'. Furthermore, the growth rate slows down after 2018, it does not show a 'steeper increase to 2019'. The steepest part of the curve is between 2016 and 2018.
